FIRST MEDAL 🫡

The Philippines secures its maiden medal in the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan, courtesy of the women's soft tennis team, which still bags a bronze despite its 2-0 loss to the hosts in the semifinals on Sunday, September 20.

The bronze marks the first-ever Asian Games medal for Philippine soft tennis, more than three decades after the sport made its continental debut.

MANILA – The Philippines bagged its first medal at the 20th Asian Games after the women's soft tennis team bowed to defending champion Japan, 0-2, in the semifinals at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Nagoya, Japan on Sunday.
The Philippine women's tennis team of (from left) Hilary Paas, Princess Catindig, Bien Zoleta, Christy Sañosa, Shyryn Salazar deliver in the 2026 Asian Games.

Less than 24 hours after the opening ceremony, the country won its first medal courtesy of the women’s soft tennis team, which bagged a bronze despite its 2-0 loss to defending champion Japan in the semifinals at the Higashiyama Park Tennis Center on Sunday, September 20.

Aside from delivering the Philippines’ maiden medal in this edition of the continental showpiece, the quintet of Bien Zoleta, Princess Catindig, Hilary Paas, Shyryn Salazar, and Christy Sañosa made history as the country secured its first podium finish in Asian Games soft tennis.
The Philippine women’s soft tennis team officially secured the bronze medal at the 2026 Asian Games after ending its campaign with a 2-0 loss to host Japan on Sunday.
The Philippine women’s team secured the bronze medal — Team Philippines’ first medal at the 20th Asian Games.
MANILA, Philippines–The Philippines women’s soft tennis fell to heavy favorite Japan, 2-0, in the semifinals on Sunday to finish with a bronze medal in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026.
Soft tennis earned the distinction as the country’s first medal in the Asian Games which formally opened a day earlier.
Despite the defeat, the Philippine quintet secured a historic place in the podium, a first since the sport became an official sport at the Asian Games.
The Philippine women’s soft tennis team which won bronze in the Asian Games 2026.
The Philippine women's soft tennis team at the 2026 Asian Games, September 20, 2026.
The Filipinas officially secured the bronze medal after falling 2-0 to host Japan in the semifinals on Sunday.
Despite the semifinal loss, the Philippine women’s soft tennis team had previously described its medal finish as a major victory , ending the country’s medal drought in the sport.
Shyryn Salazar and Hilary Paas are also part of the Philippine team.
MANILA, Philippines — Gumawa ng kasaysa­yan ang Philippine wo­men’s national soft tennis team matapos makatiyak ng bronze medal kahapon sa 20th Asian Games sa Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.

Kasama ni Zoleta sa national squad sina Princess Catindig, Shyryn Salazar, Christy Sañosa at Hilary Paas.

The Philippine squad is composed of Hilary Paas, Princes Catindig, Bien Zoleta, Christy Sañosa, and Shyryn Salazar.
Japan eventually prevailed, 2-0, ending the Philippines’ bid to advance to the final.
